analogy.rationale: Thyroid hormone receptor is a nuclear receptor with limited expression in most of these cell lines, so thyroid hormone inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional response; other nuclear receptor ligands acting on receptors poorly expressed in these cells are the closest analogs, though even they may show weak effects.
